verdict.rationale: Square's own docs say Tap to Pay on iPhone accepts contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets in person. The Mobile Payments SDK docs state this works on iPhone "without additional hardware", which matches taking tap payments on an off-the-shelf phone without buying a reader. Card acceptance is limited to a set of supported countries. missing for 10: evidence of Tap to Pay on Android phones, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world use.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Accept contactless payments with your iPhone and the Mobile Payments SDK without additional hardware.
